features.note: Top renders as a dark charcoal-grey slab only marginally lighter than the background — not the promised mid-grey 304 value. Almost no directional satin sheen across the surface; reflections are flat and value-crushed, reading closer to dark matte plastic than brushed stainless. The turned-down edge apron catches no distinct highlight, so the front edge does not separate from the top. Fails the raised 0.78 foundation threshold.

Four round tubular legs of correct slim gauge are clearly present, tied by a visible full-width undershelf; bullet feet read at each leg tip on the floor. Reads as a commercial welded frame, not solid slab legs. Legs are also under-lit and dark, but the frame vocabulary is legible.

Long 3:1 top over an open frame reads as a large prep bench, not a small side table; top is thin (skin + apron), not a thick block; undershelf clearance and work height read plausible for a 1.8 m person beside it.

defects: Top surface value is far too dark — a charcoal grey nearly matching the dark background instead of a clearly lighter mid-grey; the asset barely separates from its ground.
No visible directional brushed sheen or value gradient across the top; the surface reads flat and matte, not satin metal.
Turned-down front edge apron produces no highlight or tonal break, so the apron and top merge into one flat plane.
Legs and undershelf are equally value-crushed, with only faint metallic glints — the whole asset appears under-lit.
Reflections are dull and low-contrast, losing the 'metal' read that distinguishes stainless from painted/plastic panels.
corrections: Raise the overall exposure/lighting on the asset so the brushed-304 top lands at a clearly mid-grey value that separates from the dark background (target a top noticeably lighter than the ground plane).
Introduce a directional brushed-satin cue on the top: an anisotropic or subtly varying specular so a soft sheen gradient reads across the length, not a flat fill.
Add a key/rim highlight that grazes the turned-down front edge apron so the apron catches a bright line and separates from the top plane.
Strengthen the key or add environment contribution so the metal picks up soft graded reflections (metal read) rather than a uniform dull tone; keep roughness satin (~0.34) not matte.
Re-check tone mapping/exposure so metalness 0.95 surfaces do not crush to near-background value under ACESFilmic.

mechanical.note: console clean; draws 15 vs the 12 target — acceptable for a standalone materials gate since the 12-draw budget assumes the later optimization-pass merge (legs+shelf+feet); tris 650 far under the 30000 budget. No invariant suite for this asset.
